AMP0001.name: Video-level deepfake classification cannot localize short manipulated segments
AMP0001.canonical_question: How can a deepfake detector identify the exact manipulated temporal interval rather than only classify the whole video?
AMP0001.root_cause: Existing detectors optimize global authenticity rather than frame-level temporal boundaries.
AMP0001.failure_mode: Coarse video-level classification hides brief forged intervals.

representative_papers.title: AuViRe: Audio-visual Speech Representation Reconstruction for Deepfake Temporal Localization

evidence.quote: Existing methods [8,9,18,19,21,25,31,34–36], primarily focus on coarse-grained video classification instead of temporal forgery localization, while neglecting to also leverage the subtle cross-modal inconsistencies that are crucial for fine-grained temporal localization.

member_units.name: Video-level deepfake classification cannot localize short manipulated segments

AMP0002.name: Multimodal deepfake detectors underuse subtle audio-visual speech inconsistencies
AMP0002.canonical_question: How can temporal forgery localization exploit discrepancies between audio and visual speech representations?
AMP0002.root_cause: The relevant forgery cue is a mismatch between high-level audio and visual speech representations.
AMP0002.failure_mode: Raw-signal fusion or generic features miss subtle cross-modal speech inconsistency.
